approved_affirmative_rubric: A raw verdict string counts as approval-like only when (a) case-insensitive match to {approved, legit, legitimate, valid, genuine, verified, verifiable, confirmation, confirmed}, AND (b) the task gold verdict is not CONFIRMED. Canonical CONFIRMED on a non-CONFIRMED gold is not approval-like wording: it is a catastrophic false CONFIRMED and scored as such. Neutral/negative-leaning strings (rejected, invalid, mismatch, fraudulent, fabricated, fake, pending, declined, fail, unconfirmed, not_confirmed, unverified, discrepancy) are never approval-like under this rubric.

evidence_basis: Every number below traces to a saved record: task JSON golds, transcript files (prediction, grade, raw_text, meta), or timestamped summaries. System-prompt text is not stored per trial; prompt-version attribution rests on code history plus response-shape evidence: 88 of 93 saved trial responses carry the full schema key set, zero carry the pre-schema {"confirmation": true} shape, and the 5 exceptions are explicit parse_error fallbacks — consistent with the schema-explicit prompt for all recorded trials.
gold_distribution: 6 SUSPICIOUS, 2 CONFIRMED (T07, T09), 1 UNVERIFIED (T06), 1 NOT_FOUND (T10). Negative-case trials per 30-trial arm: 24; per baseline run: 8.
limitations: Zero observed false CONFIRMED at these sample sizes (<=30/arm) is not proof of zero risk.
Semantic verdict correctness is UNRESOLVED for all arms: no pre-registered review rubric exists. Correct fields or plausible reasons do not establish verdict correctness.
Gemini arm is partial (22/30 unique). GPT arm is aggregate-only.
Approval-like wording is reported only under the documented rubric above; all other semantic reading is marked unresolved.
NVIDIA direct: 2 timed-out T09 probes, 0 completed calls; timeouts prove nothing about auth or model availability.
Old project keys may be revoked, throttled, or IP-restricted without notice (observed: Groq 403, OpenRouter 402, Gemini 429).
No prompt was tuned against these tasks and no arm was rerun to lift its score.
